content: Session: hardware-readiness pass + execfilter repo. Installer repo (developDinit): setup.sh deps-before-clone+cd+absolute-config, wizard rewritten (per-field validation re-ask, all options, yes/no restart with previous-as-defaults, min-6 password), exported per-field validators utils/config/validators.go + LoadInternalRules enums, shell manual-retry askLoop fix, serial console gated behind enableDebug (fixtures+template true, real-hw false hardened), internal_rules btrfsUnencrypted entry + intel drivers modernized, harness log_errors liberror-perl allowlist, harness run btrfs_standard_minimal 38/39 (only scanner false positive). New repo github.com/skea999/execfilter: Rust LD_PRELOAD shim filtering nixGL env vars for non-nix children (DMS/quickshell context), Rust core 6 hooks + execl/execlp in C (VaList nightly-only), glibc-only (NOT aports), Docker-based local verification (rust:latest, no host toolchain), CI green x86_64+aarch64 glibc with 8/8 hook dynsym assertion, releases on v* tags. Key lessons: rustc cdylib emits auto version-script localizing non-no_mangle symbols (C TU needs whole-archive + own version-script); bfd ld rejects two anonymous version scripts (lld merges) — aarch64 needed -B<sysroot>/lib/rustlib/<target>/bin/gcc-ld + -fuse-ld=lld mirroring rustc x86_64 shim; CStr::as_bytes removed in rustc 1.98 (to_bytes). Next: feralos-aports APKBUILDs feralos-niri-session + feralos-niri-config (real-hw only, NO VM software-rendering workarounds), audit installer niri.go for VM workarounds, feralos-control repo later.
